def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize island labels (strip spaces, fix case variants)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # body_mass_g stored as text, some with thousands separators
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # flipper_length_mm may be text and contains erroneous negatives (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    # drop rows with missing/invalid body mass or species (needed for the question)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g', 'species'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    grouped = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
